proposals.name: City of Menominee Proposed Ordinance Amendment
proposals.description:
Initiation of an ordinance pursuant to the Michigan Regulation and Taxation of Marihuana Act to amend Section 11.3 of the Menominee Code of Ordinances to provide for no more than thirteen (13) marihuana retail establishments to be allowed within the city limits.
Should the proposal be adopted?
proposals.ballotLanguage:
Initiation of an ordinance pursuant to the Michigan Regulation and Taxation of Marihuana Act to amend Section 11.3 of the Menominee Code of Ordinances to provide for no more than thirteen (13) marihuana retail establishments to be allowed within the city limits.
Should the proposal be adopted?
proposals.officialTitle: City of Menominee Proposed Ordinance Amendment
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote approves a new levy of the levy described in the ballot language — this is a tax increase.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote rejects the new tax; your property tax rate stays where it is.
proposals.conservativeView: This is new taxation. Ask whether the need could be met within existing budgets, whether the millage sunsets, and who oversees how the money is spent.
proposals.progressiveView: New funding dedicated to a specific local service that supporters say current revenue cannot cover.

proposals.name: Stephenson Township Millage Increase for Stephenson Fire Department
proposals.description: Shall the Township of Stephenson levy a new additional millage of 0.25 mil ($0.25 per $1,000 of taxable value) for three years, 2026 through 2028 inclusive, for the purpose of assisting with the Stephenson Fire Department operations and equipment and shall the Township levy such millage, which is estimated to raise $8,312.75 in the first year the millage is levied.
proposals.ballotLanguage: Shall the Township of Stephenson levy a new additional millage of 0.25 mil ($0.25 per $1,000 of taxable value) for three years, 2026 through 2028 inclusive, for the purpose of assisting with the Stephenson Fire Department operations and equipment and shall the Township levy such millage, which is estimated to raise $8,312.75 in the first year the millage is levied.
proposals.officialTitle: Stephenson Township Millage Increase for Stephenson Fire Department
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote approves a new levy of 0.25 mills for 3 years — this is a tax increase.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote rejects the new tax; your property tax rate stays where it is.
proposals.conservativeView: This is new taxation. Ask whether the need could be met within existing budgets, whether the millage sunsets, and who oversees how the money is spent.
proposals.progressiveView: New funding dedicated to a specific local service that supporters say current revenue cannot cover.
